messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SLO: p99 latency breach detected for eu-dedicated-pool-3 (streaming). p99=11.8s (> SLO 6s). Alert group: dedicated-capacity. Triggered at 1714012345.

maria (ops): ack — oncall paged, moving to triage. @ash you’re on rotation, can you take initial? :phone:

ash (oncall): on it. grabbing logs + scales. first glance: queue depth spiked to 420 for pool eu-dedicated-pool-3, tail latency on streaming RPCs. hitting hotshot traffic bursts from customer C.

ash (oncall): checking autoscaler: history shows scale request at 1714012278 -> provision request id=pr-98a3 pending -> no capacity attached for 45s. warmup state stuck for several hosts (ready=false).

priya (sre): logs snippet: ```[2024-04-23T12:05:10Z] autoscaler: req=pr-98a3 state=PENDING
[2024-04-23T12:05:25Z] warmup: node=eu-gpu-12 ready=false reason=kv-cache-coldpath
[2024-04-23T12:05:50Z] pool: queue_depth=420 p95=4.2s p99=11.8s```

jon (eng-runtime): probable handshake delay between orchestration and serving runtime — we’ve seen the warmup kv-cache coldpath slow initialization for large-model streaming. can we failover traffic to eu-dedicated-pool-spare?

maria (ops): can we route? what's the risk?

jon (eng-runtime): risk: spare pool has same model but lower burst headroom; fine for short-term. Command to flip quick route (ops only): ```./routectl promote-route --from=eu-dedicated-pool-3 --to=eu-dedicated-pool-spare --weight=0.6```

ash (oncall): running promotion with conservative weight 0.5 now. will monitor. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Promotion job started (job id=prom-4421). ETA ~15s.

ash (oncall): traffic changing. queue depth on pool-3 down to 210. p99 dropping to 8.7s. still above SLO but trending.

priya (sre): customer impact check: streaming aborts recorded for ~1.2% of requests from prod cluster for customer C during 12:04–12:09 UTC. CS notified. Sam, please confirm customer notification tone.

sam (product): acknowledged. We'll send proactive note: degraded streaming quality for short window, teams are mitigating. No data loss reported.

jon (eng-runtime): additional mitigation: toggle fallback to quantized variant for high-latency requests to reduce memory pressure. patch route to use model: gptx-q4b when pool queue > 150. snippet: ```route.rules.append({"match":"streaming && queue>150","model":"gptx-q4b"})```

maria (ops): enable rule as temporary measure. Doing it now.

ash (oncall): rule applied. observing lower memory churn on nodes. warmup events still trickling but provisioning progressing (some nodes moved ready=true).

priya (sre): telemetry: p95 now 2.1s, p99 5.4s. getting close to SLO. streaming stalls reduced (in-flight window shrank).

jon (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: autoscaler handshake timeout + kv-cache population path slow for large models + single hot customer burst exceeded burst capacity threshold. Should add mitigations: pre-warm policy for hotshot customers, reduce autoscaler handshake timeout jitter, and improve KV population parallelism.

maria (ops): agreed — immediate playbook: 1) keep route weighting to spare pool at 0.5; 2) keep quantized fallback rule; 3) manual allocation: request 2 reserved nodes to eu-dedicated-pool-3 from capacity team; 4) follow-up RFC for pre-warm.

ash (oncall): manual capacity request submitted (ticket CAP-4521). ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: Manual capacity allocate job queued (job id=alloc-2104).

ash (oncall): alloc job completed. 2 nodes attached and warmed. queue depth back to 30. p99 = 3.2s, p95 = 1.1s. streaming errors falling toward baseline.

sam (product): customer C confirmed improved behavior; they saw partial retries but no data corruption. We'll follow with a post-mortem blurb.

priya (sre): marking incident as mitigated at 1714012675. will keep monitoring for 30m.

maria (ops): moving to handoff -> post-incident review. action items: (a) autoscaler handshake telemetry to be instrumented, (b) pre-warm playbook for top 10 customers, (c) routing rule defaults for streaming fallbacks. owners: jon, priya, maria.

jon (eng-runtime): I'll open a follow-up PR for KV parallelism and add a circuit in handshake path to fail-fast on provision stalls.

priya (sre): will draft postmortem for oncall review. assign severity P2 (customer-visible transient SLO breach).

maria (ops): thanks team. closing live thread — if anything regresses ping #incidents. :white_check_mark:
